svg.title: Six engineering format representations
svg.desc: The cards show BDF and INP geometry decks; VTU and MSH meshes with numeric fields; FRD mesh with nodal fields; and an OP2 displacement table with an optional separate mesh. Mesh-bearing representations share the same topology.
svg.text: Mesh-bearing outputs retain cell topology; carried fields depend on the input.
Routes and conditions are specified in the matrix below.
T1 T2 T3 R1 R2 R3
Schematic only: field availability depends on the source; OP2 needs pyNastran and a matching mesh for reading.
